data_description.gateway_host: IP address of the OpenWrt router that acts as your gateway. This host must be reachable over SSH from Home Assistant.
data_description.ssh_key_path: Absolute path to the SSH private key on the HA host used to authenticate as root. Example: /config/ssh/id_ed25519
data_description.ssh_port: SSH port on all OpenWrt hosts (gateway and APs). Default: 22.
data_description.ap_hosts: Comma-separated IPs of additional OpenWrt access points. Leave empty if you only have a gateway. Example: 192.168.1.22,192.168.1.23

provision_key.title: Add SSH key to OpenWrt devices
provision_key.description: Key authentication failed. Enter credentials to automatically add the public key to each OpenWrt device. The password is not stored.

data_description.ssh_user: SSH username on the OpenWrt device. Default: root.
data_description.ssh_password: SSH password. Used once to provision the key, never stored.

error.ssh_key_not_found: SSH key file not found at the specified path
error.auth_failed: SSH authentication failed — check key and root access
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to gateway — check IP and network
error.no_response: Connected but gateway returned no hostname
error.pub_key_unreadable: Cannot read public key from the private key file
error.provision_auth_failed: Password authentication failed — check username and password
error.provision_cannot_connect: Cannot connect to device for provisioning — check IP and network
error.auth_failed_after_provision: Key was provisioned but authentication still failed — try reloading the integration

data_description.ssh_key_path: Absolute path to the SSH private key on the HA host. Example: /config/ssh/id_ed25519
data_description.ssh_port: SSH port on all OpenWrt hosts (gateway and APs). Default: 22.
data_description.ap_hosts: Comma-separated IPs of OpenWrt access points to collect Wi-Fi associations and host stats from. Example: 192.168.1.22,192.168.1.23
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the gateway and APs. Minimum 30 s, maximum 3600 s. Default: 60 s.
data_description.lan_iface: Bridge interface used for the LAN on OpenWrt. Default: br-lan. Change only if your router uses a different name.
data_description.wan_iface: WAN-facing interface on the gateway used to read RX/TX byte counters. Default: eth0.
data_description.disconnect_threshold_s: How long a device must be absent before a disconnect event is recorded. Default: 120 s (2 missed scans at 60 s interval).
data_description.presence_macs: Comma-separated MAC addresses to track as presence binary sensors. Each MAC becomes a binary_sensor.wrtsensor_presence_* entity. Example: aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff,11:22:33:44:55:66

error.ssh_key_not_found: SSH key file not found at the specified path
